title: I'm Building an Interactive AI Idol Companion Game
author: NarrowJudge6751
selftext:
I've been working on **FIRST SIGNAL**, an interactive experience built around a fictional four-member K-pop boy group.

nstead of following a fixed storyline or just chatting with AI characters, you can interact with them through messages, daily updates, photos, and voice notes. In future versions, they'll remember your conversations, react to your choices, and build unique memories with you over time.

I've also made their first music video to bring their world and story to life.

**Playable demo:** [https://first-signal-one.vercel.app/?reset=1](https://first-signal-one.vercel.app/?reset=1)

It's still an early prototype, but I'd love to hear what other game devs think! Thank you for watching.
